title: Fast Inference of Mixture-of-Experts Language Models with Offloading
technique: MoE expert offloading with LRU expert cache, speculative expert pre-loading, and mixed HQQ quantization (attention 4-bit, experts 2/3-bit)

optimized_metrics.evidence: we focus on the task of generating tokens interactively, i.e. generate multiple tokens per second at batch size 1
we study the problem of running large MoE language models on consumer hardware with limited accelerator memory
Based on these evaluations, we chose two quantization schemes ... that offer favourable performance-size trade-offs within the target hardware constraints.

headline_claim.text: we build can run Mixtral-8x7B with mixed quantization on desktop hardware and free-tier Google Colab instances. [...] run this model interactively at 2-3 tokens per second

metric_definitions.definition_quote: measuring the average number of tokens generated per second with batch size 1
metric_definitions.notes: batch=1 generation speed on OpenAssistant conversations; sampling without temperature

tradeoff_acknowledged: quantization lowers quality (perplexity) for smaller size; 2-bit experts degrade perplexity
hardware: free-tier Colab T4, RTX 3080 Mobile, RTX 3060, A100
workloads: OpenAssistant conversations; WikiText2, C4, MMLU for quality
extractor_notes: Throughput not claimed; no formal objective or SLO. Metric is single-user generation speed (TOKEN_LAT-like). Mapped to TPS_USER; TOKEN_LAT is a defensible alternative.
